baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence تَّرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً ... مُدَّكِر makes an unspecified feminine remainder serve remembrance.
baseline_models.mechanism: Leaving preserves an effect beyond the originating event; its visible sign-status makes that residue a device for restoring what is absent to awareness.

activation_trace.role: Keeping an effect after departure supplies the durable residue that carries the mechanism.
The visible-mark image makes the residue publicly legible rather than merely left behind.
The reminder image assigns the mark its function of bringing an absent matter back into presence.

changed_reading.before: Something was left as a sign, followed by a generic appeal to remember.
changed_reading.after: An intentionally durable residue is kept in view so an absent event can be re-presented in a recipient's awareness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object-plus-state construction in تَّرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً can make signhood the state in which the referent is left.
baseline_models.mechanism: The leaving act does not merely spare an already independent sign; it fixes the remainder in a sign-bearing state, while recollection is the human completion of that arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a thing in a resulting condition supplies the transition into stable sign-status.
The manifest-mark image names the resulting condition imposed on the remainder.
Recollection after absence supplies the recipient-side act that realizes the sign's purpose.

changed_reading.before: A surviving object independently counts as a sign.
changed_reading.after: The act of leaving installs the object in a continuing sign-role that remains incomplete until someone recollects through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Temporal approach and visible splitting turn the preserved mark into a boundary signal: a rupture makes an approaching endpoint perceptible before it is fully present.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-mark image anchors the threshold reading in the focus sign.
Nearness in time and a thing's ending supply the approaching boundary that the sign announces.
Splitting and opening supply a visible breach through which the temporal boundary becomes legible.

structural_cues: 54:1 places temporal approach and visible splitting before the repeated problem of recognizing a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach and physical splitting; I infer that rupture can function as a threshold marker for 54:15. A live alternative is that the split remains only the narrated event and does not model the later sign.

changed_reading.before: The left sign is a static memorial of something past.
changed_reading.after: The left sign also faces forward, marking an approaching limit by preserving a perceptible rupture.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sign can enter vision yet fail as remembrance when the viewer side-faces it and replaces its evidentiary role with a deception label; mnemonic uptake is therefore an active interpretive turn, not an optical reflex.

activation_trace.role: Recollection supplies the inward uptake that mere exposure does not guarantee.
Eye-seeing supplies successful sensory contact without yet supplying acceptance.
The same visible-sign image links the rejected sight directly to the sign left in the focus ayah.
Turning one's side supplies the directional refusal that blocks sight from becoming remembrance.
Diversion and deception supply the replacement frame used to neutralize the sign.

structural_cues: 54:2 repeats آية but sequences seeing, turning away, and relabeling before 54:15 asks whether anyone will remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory contact, side-turning, and a deception label; I infer a reception pipeline in which turning and relabeling causally block recollection. The alternative is a looser moral juxtaposition without a staged cognitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A visible sign should be sufficient to produce remembrance.
changed_reading.after: Visibility is underdetermining: a rememberer is one who resists the side-turn and hostile relabeling that can cancel an otherwise manifest sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial followed by tracking inclination forms a self-reinforcing trajectory toward settlement; remembrance becomes an interruptive act before a chosen orientation hardens into a fixed outcome.

activation_trace.role: Recollection supplies the counter-act that can restore what denial excludes from attention.
Contradiction of truth supplies the first rejection in the trajectory.
Following in another's wake supplies continued movement rather than a momentary refusal.
The inclination of the self supplies the attractor that directs the continued following.
Fixity and settlement supply the hardened endpoint against which mnemonic interruption matters.

structural_cues: 54:3 coordinates denial and desire-following before the clause that every matter becomes settled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, following, inclination, and settlement; I supply the directional arrow from repeated inclination to hardening. The settlement clause may alternatively announce an independently fixed outcome rather than a state produced by their following.

changed_reading.after: Remembering is present agency that interrupts a desire-led path before its orientation becomes settled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reports contain an arresting force and wisdom reaches its limit, yet warnings still fail to avail; the left sign is another delivery medium whose capacity to stop a course remains dormant without recipient uptake.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark supplies the focus ayah's nonverbal warning medium.
The reminder image names the successful uptake that converts warning capacity into changed attention.
A report arriving and being conveyed supplies a verbal carrier parallel to the visible sign.
Vocal rebuke and restraint supply the report's course-arresting capacity.
Prevention and corrective restraint sharpen the mechanism from information into attempted reform.
Reaching the endpoint supplies completed delivery while leaving response unresolved.
Warning that should awaken caution supplies the intended behavioral effect whose failure is stated.

structural_cues: The sequence ما فيه مزدجر ثم فما تغن النذر contrasts contained arresting capacity with actual failure to benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reports, deterrence, corrective restraint, completed reach, and ineffective warnings; I infer that the sign is a parallel carrier and recipient uptake is the missing link. The alternative is that failure belongs only to settled rejection, not to a general delivery-response mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sign passively memorializes a past event.
changed_reading.after: The sign is a braking affordance: fully delivered and capable of warning, but inert unless a recipient lets it arrest the current course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The present question permits an inward reorientation, whereas turning away is followed by a strange summons that produces hurried bodily convergence; remembering now is voluntary response before response becomes compelled.

activation_trace.role: Recollection supplies the voluntary inward response invited by the focus question.
Turning away supplies the refused orientation that precedes the later forced approach.
Calling that inclines by speech supplies the summons toward which bodies will be redirected.
The strange and severe object of the call supplies the pressure that replaces free mnemonic response.
Hurrying forward supplies the eventual bodily compliance contrasted with present recollection.

structural_cues: 54:6 and 54:8 bracket bodily response to the caller, while 54:15 frames remembrance as a present rhetorical invitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning away, a caller, a strange destination, and hurried approach; I infer a contrast between voluntary cognitive turning now and compelled bodily turning later. The live alternative is that the two calls are only sequential scenes without this choice structure.

changed_reading.before: The question merely asks whether anyone can recall the lesson.
changed_reading.after: The question opens a window for voluntary reorientation before an unavoidable summons produces outward compliance without inward remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated denial covers the servant's truthful standing; recompense leaves a durable sign that reverses this social erasure by producing lasting mention. Preservation therefore repairs reputation as well as preserving evidence.

activation_trace.role: Leaving a continuing effect supplies the durable public remainder through which erasure is reversed.
Mention as honor and repute supplies the reputational dimension of the preserved sign.
Attributing falsehood to a person supplies the repeated social negation that requires repair.
The obedient-servant image identifies the denied witness whose standing the sign can preserve.
Action answered by recompense supplies the reversal from denial to durable vindication.
Covering truth supplies the social erasure that recompense and lasting mention undo.

structural_cues: 54:9 places the servant between repeated denial, while 54:14 explicitly marks the voyage as recompense for the one who was covered or rejected.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial of the servant, recompense, covering, and a left reminder; I infer that recompense extends from rescue into enduring public mention. The live alternative is that recompense refers only to immediate rescue, with no reputational arrow.

changed_reading.before: The sign warns later audiences about the deniers' fate.
changed_reading.after: The sign also performs memory justice, restoring lasting mention to the witness whom his audience tried to erase.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opened upper channels and fissured lower channels release flows that meet under measure and bear a load; the remaining sign compresses this coordinated causal sequence rather than pointing vaguely to catastrophe.

activation_trace.role: The manifest mark anchors the claim that the preserved remainder makes a causal sequence legible.
Opening a closed entry supplies the release from above.
Pouring and outflow supply the sustained downward stream.
Wide fissuring and emission supply the answering release from below.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies the confluence that joins the releases.
Deliberate measuring and ordering supplies control over the convergent process.
Raising and bearing a visible load supplies the preserved output of the calibrated convergence.

structural_cues: 54:11-13 sequences opening, pouring, fissuring, meeting, measuring, and carrying as linked operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered operations; I infer that the left sign is a compressed causal diagram whose survival renders their coordination readable. The live alternative is that the sign points only to the vessel and not to the process encoded by its survival.

changed_reading.before: A remnant points generically back to a destructive flood.
changed_reading.after: The remnant is an index of calibrated confluence: opposed releases meet under measure and become the medium through which a load is carried.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah's feminine remainder is sharpened by the immediately prior feminine carrier made of boards and fasteners: a joined, load-bearing assembly continues through the flow under watch, materially storing the rescue.

activation_trace.role: Preserving an effect after departure supplies the assembly's continued evidentiary role.
The visible-mark image turns material survival into inspectable testimony.
Bearing an external load defines the carrier's practical rescue function.
Broad boards used for building supply the carrier's visible structural members.
Fasteners that bind shipboards supply the hidden joints that make separate members survivable as one carrier.
Flowing movement supplies proof that the assembly functions within rather than merely beside the waters.
The eye of care and preservation supplies the oversight under which material means remain effective.

structural_cues: The feminine pronoun in 54:15 follows the feminine carrier ذات ألواح ودسر in 54:13, with its motion continuing in 54:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a feminine pronoun, an immediately prior feminine carrier, its components, motion, and care; I infer the vessel as the nearest concrete antecedent and its assembly as the sign mechanism. Live alternatives are the whole episode, a vessel-form preserved by repetition, or a narrative rather than an extant artifact.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified thing remains as a symbolic reminder.
changed_reading.after: A joined survival technology becomes the sign: visible boards, concealed fasteners, load-bearing motion, and preserved function jointly testify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning question moves from a preserved material sign to facilitated gathered recitation while repeating the same invitation; mnemonic function is redundantly carried across physical and verbal media.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark supplies the material mnemonic medium from which the transition begins.
Warning intended to awaken caution preserves the behavioral purpose across the transition.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies lowered access cost for the verbal mnemonic medium.
Reading and recitation supply the repeatable verbal carrier that succeeds the material mark.
Reminder and one who takes reminder explicitly preserve the focus ayah's mnemonic function in the new medium.

structural_cues: 54:17 repeats فهل من مدكر from 54:15 after naming facilitated recitation, with 54:16 retaining warning between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies juxtaposition, repeated wording, warning, ease, and recitation; I infer functional translation from material remainder to verbal repetition. The live alternative is that 54:17 is a general refrain rather than a direct cross-media relation.

changed_reading.before: A surviving object alone bears the burden of memory.
changed_reading.after: The reminder is made resilient by cross-media redundancy: material residue can be re-presented through accessible recitation without losing its warning function.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: It is surprising to read a vessel as a document, but the focus joins visible signhood to the right-document branch of ذ ك ر and the context gives boards that can be built with or written on, bound by fasteners. Keep this as a material analogy only; downstream prose must not claim that the boards were literally inscribed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier remains anchored in آيةً as a manifest mark and مُدَّكِر as a documentary or mnemonic function.

activation_trace.role: A preserved effect supplies the archive-like persistence required by the analogy.
A visible mark supplies the document's inspectable evidentiary face.
A record or instrument of right supplies the documentary image without asserting literal writing.
Boards used for writing or building supply the cross-domain bridge from vessel structure to record surface.
Fasteners binding the boards supply syntax-like joining that makes separate surfaces one durable witness.

changed_reading.before: The boards are only construction material for a carrier.
changed_reading.after: The joined carrier can be contemplated as a built document whose material relations, rather than written sentences, preserve testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pooled-water branch of ت ر ك is form-distant from the ordinary verb and does not establish the pronoun's referent, but it is unusually activated by the pouring, fissuring, and meeting waters. Carry it only as a spatial analogy: the vessel or episode is like a deposit stranded by a passed torrent, not literally a puddle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches directly to تَّرَكْنَاهَا through the image of water left pooled after a torrent and to آيةً as the residue's mark-function.

activation_trace.role: Water left pooled after a torrent supplies the strange but exact residual spatial image.
The visible-mark image lets the stranded remainder register the passage of a larger flow.
Pouring and outflow supply the torrent-like process from which a remainder can be deposited.
Wide fissuring and emission multiply the flows that produce the residual landscape.
The meeting of opposed flows supplies the peak event whose recession the remainder can index.

changed_reading.before: Leaving means only preserving an object through time.
changed_reading.after: The sign can be imagined spatially as what a vast flow deposits when it passes, a stranded remainder whose location records the movement that produced it.

strongest_changes: Visibility is separated from remembrance: 54:2 shows that a sign can be seen, side-faced, and relabeled.
The feminine remainder becomes a joined survival assembly whose boards, fasteners, motion, and care materially store the rescue.
The flood sequence makes the sign a compressed causal diagram of opposed releases meeting under measure.
Preservation also repairs denied witness by converting social covering into lasting mention.
The repeated 54:17 question translates mnemonic function from material residue into facilitated recitation.
summary.what_was_special: The trace changes the left remainder's function without forcing one final referent: it can be threshold marker, arresting affordance, causal diagram, survival artifact, reputational recompense, and cross-media reminder.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine pronoun may denote the vessel, the whole episode, a vessel-form preserved by repetition, or a narrative rather than an extant artifact.
The causal arrow from desire-following to settlement is plausible but supplied by the reader, not explicitly asserted by the packet.
The built-document and torrent-remainder readings are branch-backed analogies and should not be rendered as literal historical claims.
